description: Apply up to 1,000 explicit edits to existing cells only. Zero-based row indices include the header. Duplicate coordinates apply in input order. Return complete CSV with literal string values; never evaluate formulas.

csv.description: Complete UTF-8 CSV text, up to 256 KiB. All cells remain strings; formulas are never evaluated.

column.description: Zero-based column index. Every data record must contain this column.
